content.tagline: We put the fun in functional skincare
content.descriptor: Jelly Ko: Korean refillable skincare for dry, dehydrated and perimenopausal skin, created by K-beauty expert Lauren Lee
about: Jelly Ko is a Korean skincare brand created by Lauren Lee, host of a Korean beauty podcast, developed together with Korean cosmetic chemists. According to the company, it was built for women experiencing skin changes — including perimenopause — whose skin has become dry, dehydrated or reactive and is underserved by products that are either too rich or too thin, or by sensitive-skin ranges the company sees as underpowered. Its legal address is in Gangnam, Seoul; its formulas are made in Korea.

The range covers cleansing, toning, serums, a night mask, a lip mask and acne-spot patches, built around a small set of active ingredients at stated concentrations rather than a long multi-step routine. Four of its core products — the Bubble Tea Steam Cream, Dewy Glaze Toner, White Truffle Soufflé Serum and Be Jelly Overnight Dream Serum — ship with a separate refill pouch or jar insert, which, according to the company, cuts single-use plastic and glass per item by more than 80%. The refill packaging uses recycled paper and soy ink, and the included scoop is zinc rather than plastic.

The company has no exclusive distributor in any market. Since mid-2026 it has shipped to Latin America through a global distributor, and already sells in Korea, Australia, the United States and other markets through pharmacies, spas and clinics, marketplaces and its own site. It can share supporting documents for a market's registration process on request. Teranova has not independently verified these sales and distribution claims beyond what is stated in Jelly Ko's own brand materials.

catalog_notes: A 3-in-1 oil, serum and cream with niacinamide 2%, adenosine, panthenol, vitamin E, beta-glucan and squalane, for daily use morning and evening; the top-selling product in the range, according to the company.

The matching refill pouch for the Bubble Tea Steam Cream, with grape seed oil, beta-glucan, niacinamide 2% and adenosine; winner of a Prevention magazine 'Best of Beauty' award for refillable skincare, according to the company.

A night mask with a patented MOISTBOOM complex, cherry blossom extract, niacinamide 2%, panthenol, ectoin 1%, betaine, allantoin and adenosine; a thin layer 20 minutes before bed, rinsed off in the morning, or used as a lightweight day moisturizer.

A combined essence-and-toner step with 84% birch sap, a layered hyaluronic acid complex, arginine, panthenol and berry extracts; applied after cleansing with a cotton pad, then pressed in by hand for a second layer.
The matching refill for the Dewy Glaze Toner, in the same volume; cuts single-use plastic by more than 90%, according to the company, also sold as a travel pack with a cap.
A multi-functional scrub that turns into foam on contact with water, with glycerin, sucrose and a multi-ceramide complex; used either as a cleanser or, left on damp skin, as an exfoliant.

A soufflé-textured serum for very dry, sensitive and compromised skin, with European white truffle, shea butter, licorice, centella asiatica, sodium hyaluronate and adenosine, without added dyes, fragrance or essential oils; one to two pumps before a moisturizer.
The matching refill for the White Truffle Soufflé Serum, in the same volume; cuts single-use plastic and glass by more than 80%, according to the company, also sold as a travel pack.

A gel-textured night serum with retinol, collagen, panthenol, squalane and four types of hyaluronic acid, for texture and tone; a thin layer before night cream, starting at one to two times a week and building up gradually.
The matching refill and travel pack for the Be Jelly Overnight Dream Serum, in the same volume and with the same use.

A lip sleeping mask with 9 essential amino acids, shea butter, sunflower seed oil, jojoba seed oil and moringa seed oil, applied with an included zinc scoop that doubles as a mini gua sha tool; a thin layer by day, a thicker layer overnight.
Ultra-thin, drug-free hydrocolloid patches for blemish spots, applied to clean dry skin and left on for 6–12 hours or overnight.
A hair-tie set matching the Cherry Blossom packaging. Teranova has not identified an ingredient or care-instruction page for this accessory in Jelly Ko's materials.
A silicone brush for applying jar-packed creams and masks without fingers, reducing product waste; rinses clean with warm water.
